sloka: न कामकारः कामं वा तव राक्षसपुङ्गव ।दैवं चेष्टयते सर्वं हतं दैवेन हन्यते ।। ६.११३.२३ ।।
transliteration: na kāmakāraḥ kāmaṁ vā tava rākṣasapuṅgava ।daivaṁ ceṣṭayate sarvaṁ hataṁ daivena hanyate ।। 6.113.23 ।।

translations.english: "O Foremost of Rakshasas! You have acted according to your desire alone is not sufficient as divine will make you do everything. He is killed whom destiny kills."
